message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: Stone (石某) went to hotel front desk, pretended to check in, asked staff to get water, then while staff distracted, stole cash 9400 yuan from front desk. This is theft (抢劫? Actually robbery requires use of violence or intimidation. He used deception and took cash without force? He used deception and maybe threat? He didn't use violence, just took cash while staff not aware. That's theft (盗窃). Could also be "抢夺" but Chinese criminal law: 盗窃罪 is taking property of others by stealth, etc. He used deception, but still theft. Not robbery because no violence or threat. So the crime is theft. Also maybe "诈骗"? He pretended to be a guest, but didn't obtain money by deception from staff; he just stole cash. So only theft.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
